notes.title: Paper on the mosque step
notes.text: Whoever tends the tandoor: the clay is tired. Two cups on the shelf would please it. Leave them by the oven, not in a stranger's hands.

notes.title: Note on the pasture post
notes.text: The dream-sheep drift into the herbs. A short wattle fence, raised from the workbench, would keep the lane kind.

notes.title: The same scrap, twice
notes.text: When the grove repeats itself, the star spring is listening. Four deeds, then the north mist thins: the mould, the cups, the braid, the runes, and the small works of the lane.

notes.title: A line on a basket
notes.text: Worn rugs, old baskets, broken pots: take them apart at the workbench. The fibre and the clay remember being useful.
